mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Richmond Hill?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. We'll confirm the rules for your lot before you order.

mainEntity.name: Can I start my sauna from my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose a HUUM UKU Wi-Fi control or a Homecraft Wi-Fi touchpad and you can preheat the sauna from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: What base does a sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A level gravel pad or concrete slab. We recommend which suits your yard and soil during the site check.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Richmond Hill?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Richmond Hill. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
